tasks.title: Kepcoin tasks
tasks.subtitle: Complete tasks across KEP.uz and collect Kepcoin rewards here.
tasks.alreadyCompleted: This task has already been completed
tasks.modalSubtitle: Complete the action, then come back and verify it.
tasks.modalHint: Some tasks open internal pages, and account connections can bring you back here automatically.
tasks.flowStepStart: 1. Start the connection flow for this account.
tasks.flowStepVerify: 2. After linking is complete, click verify to receive your reward.

verifyCodes.telegram_not_linked: Telegram account is not linked yet.
verifyCodes.google_not_linked: Google account is not linked yet.
verifyCodes.github_not_linked: GitHub account is not linked yet.
verifyCodes.missing_required_provider: A required account connection is missing.
verifyCodes.event_not_found: Task action was not detected yet.
verifyCodes.telegram_channel_not_subscribed: Telegram channel subscription was not detected.

errors.startFailed: Could not start the task flow.

provider_link.subtitle: Connect the required account, then return here to verify the task.
provider_link.hint: A new page or service will open for account linking. After the connection is completed, come back and click verify.
steps: 1. Start the account connection flow.
2. Complete the connection, return to KEP.uz, and click verify.

internal_link.subtitle: Open the related page, complete the action, then come back here.
internal_link.hint: This task is verified only after the required action is completed on KEP.uz.
steps: 1. Open the required page and complete the action.
2. Return here and click verify to receive your reward.

external_link.subtitle: Open the external page, complete the action, then verify the task here.
external_link.hint: The external page opens in a new tab. After you finish the action, return to KEP.uz and verify it.
steps: 1. Open the external page and complete the required action.
2. Return here and click verify.

connect-telegram.subtitle: Connect your Telegram account to KEP.uz through the bot.
connect-telegram.hint: A Telegram bot page will open. Start the bot from the account you want to connect, then return and verify.
steps: 1. Open the bot and press Start from your Telegram account.
2. After the account is connected, return here and click verify.

connect-google.subtitle: Connect your Google account to KEP.uz.
connect-google.hint: You will be redirected to Google sign-in. Complete the connection, then come back here to verify.
steps: 1. Sign in with the Google account you want to connect.
2. Return to KEP.uz and click verify.

connect-github.subtitle: Connect your GitHub account to KEP.uz.
connect-github.hint: You will be redirected to GitHub authorization. After the connection is approved, return and verify the task.
steps: 1. Authorize KEP.uz with your GitHub account.
2. Return here and click verify.

complete-bio.subtitle: Fill in your profile bio and save it.
complete-bio.hint: The bio must be non-empty. Simply opening the page is not enough.
steps: 1. Open profile information settings and write your bio.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

upload-avatar.subtitle: Upload a profile avatar in settings.
upload-avatar.hint: Use a real avatar image and save the changes before verifying.
steps: 1. Open settings and upload your avatar.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

upload-cover-photo.subtitle: Set a cover photo for your profile.
upload-cover-photo.hint: The task is counted after the cover photo is updated and saved.
steps: 1. Open settings and upload a cover photo.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

complete-birthday.subtitle: Add your date of birth in profile settings.
complete-birthday.hint: The birthday field must be filled in and saved.
steps: 1. Open profile information settings and enter your date of birth.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

complete-country-region.subtitle: Fill in both your country and region in profile settings.
complete-country-region.hint: Both fields must be saved for this task to be detected.
steps: 1. Open profile information settings and fill in country and region.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

add-three-technologies.subtitle: Add at least three technologies to your profile.
add-three-technologies.hint: This task is counted only after three or more technologies are saved.
steps: 1. Open skills settings and add at least three technologies.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

add-codeforces-handle.subtitle: Add your Codeforces handle in social settings.
add-codeforces-handle.hint: Enter a non-empty handle and save the form.
steps: 1. Open social settings and enter your Codeforces handle.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

add-education.subtitle: Add at least one education entry to your profile.
add-education.hint: Fill in the education form and save it before verifying.
steps: 1. Open the career section and add an education entry.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

add-work-experience.subtitle: Add at least one work experience entry to your profile.
add-work-experience.hint: Fill in the company and role fields, then save the form.
steps: 1. Open the career section and add a work experience entry.
2. Save the changes, return here, and click verify.

follow-user.subtitle: Follow any user on the platform.
follow-user.hint: Open a user profile or the users list and use the follow action.
steps: 1. Open the users page and follow any user.
2. Return here and click verify.

create-or-join-team.subtitle: Create a new team or join an existing one.
create-or-join-team.hint: Either creating a team or joining one counts for this task.
steps: 1. Open the teams section and create or join a team.
2. Return here and click verify.

subscribe-telegram-channel.subtitle: Subscribe to the official KEP.uz Telegram channel.
subscribe-telegram-channel.hint: Your Telegram account must already be connected before the subscription can be verified.
steps: 1. Open the Telegram channel and subscribe from your connected account.
2. Return here and click verify.

first-problem-attempt.subtitle: Submit a normal problem attempt on KEP.uz.
first-problem-attempt.hint: Only a regular problem attempt is counted for this task.
steps: 1. Open problems and submit an attempt for a regular problem.
2. Return here and click verify.

first-problem-ac.subtitle: Get your first accepted solution on a regular problem.
first-problem-ac.hint: Only an accepted solution on a regular problem is counted.
steps: 1. Open problems and solve a regular problem with an accepted solution.
2. Return here and click verify.

register-contest.subtitle: Register for any contest on the platform.
register-contest.hint: The task is counted after your contest registration is created.
steps: 1. Open contests and register for any contest.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-first-attempt.subtitle: Make at least one attempt during a contest.
contest-first-attempt.hint: Only a contest attempt counts for this task.
steps: 1. Join a contest and submit at least one attempt.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-first-solved-problem.subtitle: Solve at least one contest problem.
contest-first-solved-problem.hint: You need an accepted solution inside a contest.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and solve one problem.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-solve-all-problems.subtitle: Solve every problem in a contest.
contest-solve-all-problems.hint: This task is counted after all problems in one contest are solved.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and solve all its problems.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-top-20.subtitle: Finish a contest in the top 20.
contest-top-20.hint: The result is counted when your contest rank reaches the top 20.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and finish in the top 20.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-top-10.subtitle: Finish a contest in the top 10.
contest-top-10.hint: You need to improve your final contest rank to the top 10.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and finish in the top 10.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-top-5.subtitle: Finish a contest in the top 5.
contest-top-5.hint: This task is counted when your contest rank reaches the top 5.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and finish in the top 5.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-top-3.subtitle: Finish a contest in the top 3.
contest-top-3.hint: You need to reach a top-3 placement in a contest.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and finish in the top 3.
2. Return here and click verify.

contest-winner.subtitle: Win a contest and take 1st place.
contest-winner.hint: This task is counted only if you finish the contest in 1st place.
steps: 1. Participate in a contest and finish in 1st place.
2. Return here and click verify.

join-arena.subtitle: Register for any arena event.
join-arena.hint: The task is counted after your arena registration is created.
steps: 1. Open arena and join any arena event.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-first-match.subtitle: Play at least one arena match.
arena-first-match.hint: You need to complete a real arena match for this task to count.
steps: 1. Join an arena and complete at least one match.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-first-win.subtitle: Win at least one arena match.
arena-first-win.hint: Only a completed winning match is counted.
steps: 1. Join an arena and win one match.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-top-20.subtitle: Finish an arena in the top 20.
arena-top-20.hint: The task is counted after your arena rank reaches the top 20.
steps: 1. Participate in an arena and finish in the top 20.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-top-10.subtitle: Finish an arena in the top 10.
arena-top-10.hint: You need to improve your arena rank to the top 10.
steps: 1. Participate in an arena and finish in the top 10.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-top-5.subtitle: Finish an arena in the top 5.
arena-top-5.hint: The task is counted after your arena rank reaches the top 5.
steps: 1. Participate in an arena and finish in the top 5.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-top-3.subtitle: Finish an arena in the top 3.
arena-top-3.hint: You need to reach a top-3 placement in an arena.
steps: 1. Participate in an arena and finish in the top 3.
2. Return here and click verify.

arena-winner.subtitle: Win an arena and take 1st place.
arena-winner.hint: This task is counted only if you finish the arena in 1st place.
steps: 1. Participate in an arena and finish in 1st place.
2. Return here and click verify.

complete-course-lesson-part.subtitle: Complete any lesson part inside a course.
complete-course-lesson-part.hint: The lesson part must be marked as completed before the task can be verified.
steps: 1. Open a course and complete one lesson part.
2. Return here and click verify.

first-project-attempt.subtitle: Submit your first project attempt.
first-project-attempt.hint: The task is counted after a project attempt is sent successfully.
steps: 1. Open a project and submit an attempt.
2. Return here and click verify.

project-complete-one-part.subtitle: Complete at least one part of a project attempt.
project-complete-one-part.hint: You need to finish one project task inside an attempt.
steps: 1. Open a project attempt and complete one part.
2. Return here and click verify.

project-complete-all-parts.subtitle: Complete all parts of a project attempt.
project-complete-all-parts.hint: This task is counted only after every part in one project attempt is completed.
steps: 1. Open a project attempt and complete all parts.
2. Return here and click verify.

leave-order-review.subtitle: Leave a review for one of your orders.
leave-order-review.hint: Open your purchases, choose an order, and submit a review.
steps: 1. Open your purchases page and leave a review for an order.
2. Return here and click verify.
